import sys

P = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    table = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(n + 1):
        start = 1 if i == 0 else i
        for j in range(start, n + 1):
            if i == 0:
                table[i][j] = (table[i][j - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P
            else:
                table[i][j] = (table[i - 1][j] + table[i][j - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P

    print(table[n][n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
